# Owl Park

> A cozy park you visit in your browser, no download. Wander as an owl, alongside everyone else who is here right now. Built for anyone who misses the old chatroom worlds: grown-up owls welcome.

Owl Park is in early preview. Guests play free and keep nothing they win; ticketed owls keep everything. There is no typed chat: owls talk only with set phrases. Nothing is sold inside the park; a Day Ticket is bought in the store's checkout.

## Pages

- [Play Owl Park](https://exploreowlpark.com/): make an owl and come in
- [About Owl Park](https://exploreowlpark.com/about/): what it is, who it is for, and a note for grown-ups
- [What's new](https://exploreowlpark.com/changelog/): every change, with its date
